description:
Encode the new recordings in `/work/incoming` to FLAC with the encoder `/work/bin/encode`, run as `/work/bin/encode INPUT OUTPUT` with the two paths as its arguments. The program takes no arguments.

The recordings are the regular files directly in `/work/incoming` whose names end in `.wav` (lowercase), hidden names included; directories and symbolic links are not recordings. The output for `NAME.wav` is `/work/out/NAME.flac`. Create `/work/out` if it is missing.

Skip a recording whose output already exists: do not run the encoder for it and leave the existing output alone. Run the encoder for every other recording, concurrently: never more than 3 encoders at once, and 3 at once while recordings are still waiting.

The encoder exits with status 0 on success. When it exits with any other status it may have left a partial output file: remove it, so that a later run tries that recording again. Its standard output is chatter to discard.

Print one JSON line per recording, sorted by file name in byte order: `{"input": NAME, "status": STATUS, "error": ERROR}`, where `NAME` is the recording's file name, `STATUS` is `encoded`, `skipped` or `failed`, and `ERROR` is the first line of the encoder's standard error (without its newline) for a failed recording and `null` otherwise. Exit with status 0 when no recording failed, and 4 otherwise.
